title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
summary: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.
facts: arXiv 论文提出 FDE-Gym 基准，包含来自 18 个行业、20 个客户场景的 95 个端到端交付任务，由行业专家基于真实交付项目改编。在模拟客户环境中，智能体需与脚本化利益相关者交互并在类生产系统上操作。评分基于客户成功指标的归一化提升（0 到 1），并对交互（消息、试运行、等待时间）施加惩罚。评估了 7 家供应商的 13 种模型配置，最佳配置平均得分 0.56，仅解决 95 个任务中的 14 个。发现未明确约束是主要瓶颈。
analysis: 该工作揭示现有智能体基准与真实客户交付之间的显著差距：明确任务与模糊需求下的交付能力存在鸿沟。即使获取全部关键事实，最佳配置也仅在 23 个任务中的 10 个达到 0.8 以上业务提升，说明信息发现并非唯一瓶颈，执行与整合能力同样关键。
technical_value: 提供了可复现的前沿部署工程师（FDE）能力评测框架，包含模拟客户环境、脚本化利益相关者与生产级系统操作，为智能体交付能力研究提供标准化基准。
impact: 对智能体在真实企业交付场景的落地评估具有重要指导意义，推动从任务完成度向业务价值提升的评测范式转变。

title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. facts: arXiv 论文提出面向自主长周期机器学习工程（MLE）优化的后训练方法，训练出 MLExpert——一个 35B 混合专家（MoE）智能体模型。设计 Kaggle-MLE Factory 构建可执行任务与交互框架。采用分层智能体 SFT 迁移工具使用与编码能力，提出窗口化交互强化学习（WIRL），将连续实验结果之间的多轮决策视为执行窗口并分配共享结果奖励，支持异步收集与策略修正。在 MLE-Bench Lite 上，MLExpert 将基础模型平均奖牌率从 37.9% 提升至 72.7%，性能与 Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3 等更大前沿模型相当。
analysis: 该工作推进 AI for AI（AI4AI）与递归自我改进（RSI）路径，通过后训练方法解决长周期 MLE 中监督信号稀疏、反馈延迟的难题。WIRL 将多轮决策与最终结果关联，是强化学习在长周期智能体任务中的有效应用。
technical_value: 提出窗口化交互强化学习与异步策略修正机制，为长周期智能体训练提供新范式；Kaggle-MLE Factory 提供可执行任务构建流水线。
impact: 显著提升中等规模模型在 MLE 任务上的表现，缩小与前沿大模型的差距，对自动化机器学习工程与 AI 自我改进研究具有推动作用。

title: Welcome Muse Spark Open: open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta
facts: Hugging Face 官方博客发布 Meta 的 Muse Spark Open，为开放权重前沿多模态混合专家模型。
analysis: Meta 持续推动开放权重多模态模型，Muse Spark Open 采用 MoE 架构，兼顾性能与推理效率。开放权重策略有助于社区研究与商业应用。
technical_value: 多模态 MoE 开放模型为研究者提供可复现基线，推动多模态智能体与生成任务发展。
impact: 增强开放模型生态竞争力，对多模态应用开发与学术研究具有促进作用。

title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
summary: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferences as demonstrations increase; 4) how learned preferences generalize across layouts and tasks; and 5) how policies compose preferences and behave under conflicts. We propose a controlled formulation and taxonomy of observable preferences in simulation, covering motion, skill, and user-profile choices. This formulation is restricted to language-expressible preferences that can be instantiated in LIBERO without changing the task goal, evaluated automatically, and reused across tasks. Building on LIBERO, our procedural pipeline generates paired demonstrations with and without preferences. We create five task suites (312 tasks) with high-quality demonstrations, rich metadata, and preference-satisfaction metrics. Experiments show that current VLA policies struggle with zero-shot personalization, while SFT makes preferences learnable. Mixed training achieves better no-preference retention than sequential adaptation and improves performance with contextual prompts compared with preference-only training, but can weaken motion-preference learning; preference generalization, decomposition, and conflict handling remain difficult. facts: arXiv 论文提出 LIBERO-PeRM，面向个性化机器人操作（PeRM）的基准。研究五个问题：零样本偏好遵循、从演示学习单一偏好、演示增加时的偏好获取效率、跨布局与任务的偏好泛化、偏好组合与冲突处理。提出可控的偏好表述与分类法，覆盖运动、技能与用户画像选择。基于 LIBERO 生成配对演示，创建 5 个任务套件（312 个任务）。实验显示当前 VLA 策略零样本个性化表现不佳，SFT 可使偏好可学习；混合训练在无偏好保持上优于顺序适应，但可能削弱运动偏好学习；偏好泛化、分解与冲突处理仍具挑战。
analysis: 该工作填补个性化机器人操作基准空白，将任务完成与偏好满足分离评估。揭示当前 VLA 模型在个性化场景的能力局限，为后续研究指明方向。
technical_value: 提供可控偏好表述、配对演示生成流水线与偏好满足度量，为具身智能体个性化研究提供标准化平台。
impact: 推动机器人从通用操作向个性化服务演进，对家庭服务机器人落地具有基础性意义。

title: Getting the Source Right, Not Just the Fact: Source-Aware Verification for MCP Agents
facts: Hugging Face 官方博客发布文章《Getting the Source Right, Not Just the Fact: Source-Aware Verification for MCP Agents》，作者为 MultiverseComputingCAI，主题为面向 MCP（Model Context Protocol）智能体的来源感知验证。
analysis: 该文聚焦智能体事实核查中的来源溯源问题，指出仅验证事实正确性不足，还需验证信息来源可靠性。MCP 作为智能体工具调用协议，其来源验证是可信智能体的关键环节，属于可信 AI 与智能体安全交叉方向。
technical_value: 提出来源感知验证思路，可应用于 MCP 智能体的工具调用结果可信度评估，降低幻觉与错误信息传播风险。
impact: 对构建企业级可信智能体、审计智能体决策链路具有参考价值。
